name: North Coast
summary: Fog hangs over North Coast, where blight and murlocs rule the shore. Cold sands mark Tirisfal Glades' northern edge, strewn with rotting sea life.

sections.title: A Blighted Shoreline
sections.body: Before the Third War, North Coast's waters and stony beaches made a peaceful northern boundary for Lordaeron. Then the Plague of Undeath swept across the continent, and its blight seeped down the bluffs to poison the coast. The waters turned cold and murky. Now giant sea creatures wash ashore and rot beneath the lingering fog.

sections.title: The Vile Fin Shore
sections.body: With Lordaeron shattered, the Forsaken focus on Brill and the Capital City. Along the surf, the Vile Fin tribe keeps huts and uses nearby shallows as spawning grounds. Ravenous murlocs gather there, among them Deeb and growing tadpoles. They fiercely guard the tideline against surface-dwellers.

faq.q: What creatures inhabit the North Coast?
faq.answer: Aggressive Vile Fin murlocs inhabit the beach, with their tadpoles and scavengers that pick over rotting sea life washed ashore from the Great Sea.
Deeb is a murloc found along North Coast, among the shore's huts and shallows.

faq.q: Why is the coast covered in rotting carcasses?
faq.answer: The Plague of Undeath devastated Lordaeron, and its blight seeped into the coast and poisoned it. Dead marine beasts wash ashore and decay on the blighted sand.

faq.q: Is the North Coast contested by any major factions?
faq.answer: Neither the Forsaken nor remnants of the Alliance actively garrison North Coast. The shore remains untamed, left largely to murlocs and sea vermin.

angles.text: Forsaken patrols follow the road through Brill. Clearing North Coast of encroaching murlocs helps keep Tirisfal Glades' northern flank relatively secure.
